in_arabic.name: dimah
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Mother of the Beloved
in_arabic.long_meaning: dimah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Arabic, 'dimah' is derived from the root 'd-m-h', which symbolizes love, attachment, and maternal affection. This name is believed to have been used for the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) wife, Umm Dhul-Fikar, who showed immense love and devotion towards her husband.
